set_aside.subject: Imported project display-name default
set_aside.text: “the display name and alias each will arrive under — its v1 name and no alias unless the owner gives others” contradicts “a display name ... absent or blank is ... a missing value”
set_aside.question: When the owner picks a project but omits its display-name override, does the mapping use the v1 name or remain non-clean because the display name is missing?
options: Use the v1 project name when the override is absent; treat only an explicitly blank override as missing.
Treat an absent or blank display-name input as missing, requiring the owner to enter every imported project's name explicitly.
set_aside.default_guess: Use the v1 name when the override is absent and treat an explicitly blank override as missing.

witness.initial: An accepted uploaded file contains project P with readable v1 name “Reforma Progreso”; the migration closure is absent.
events: The owner selects P in mapping mode and supplies no replacement display name.
outcomes: The mapping says P will arrive as “Reforma Progreso” and may be clean.
The mapping lists P's display name as missing and is not clean, so no confirmation step is shown.
witness.observer: The owner using the import mapping page

set_aside.subject: Invalid owner-supplied Customer kind
set_aside.text: “for each Customer ... its name, its kind” and “a Customer's name or kind absent or blank is no refusal here but a missing value” do not say what happens when a present kind is outside the closed vocabulary; the operation's Errors list assigns `outside_closed_list` only to an unknown pick or an extraneous Customer v1 value
set_aside.question: How does mapping mode represent or refuse a present Customer kind other than `person` or `company`?
options: Return the mapping as non-clean with a defect attached to that Customer, deferring the import refusal to confirmation.
Treat the invalid kind as a missing value in the returned non-clean mapping.

witness.initial: An accepted upload has picked project P naming v1 customer value C; the closure is absent and all imported records are otherwise valid.
events: The owner supplies C's name and supplies kind `association`.
outcomes: The mapping call is refused immediately with `invalid_request` and `outside_closed_list`.
The mapping is returned but marked non-clean, with C's kind shown as defective or missing; only confirmation has the import-level refusal.
witness.observer: The owner interface and the operations module handling the mapping result
